cases.name: ANSWER-AB-002
cases.query: 1. How to install CESS-HV-9.4K battery?
cases.reference:
This is CESS-HV-9.4K battery. During its installation, pay attention to the following points. 
Make sure the ground is level and strong enough to bear the weight of products.
Before you start connecting cables, make sure that the inverter and battery are entirely switched off!
Make sure there is no water source above or near the battery, including downspouts, sprinklers, or faucets.
The altitude to install the equipment shall be lower than the maximum working altitude 2000m.
Install the equipment away from electromagnetic interference. If there is any radio or wireless communication device below 30MHz near the equipment, make sure that the equipment is at least 30m far away from the wireless device.
Step 1: Locate drill holes on the floor
Place the base along the wall and the base distance from the wall is 25-55mm. There are positioning holes on all sides of the base. Locating drill holes on the floor using the base as a template, mark the positions of the 4 holes, and then drill 10mm holes to ensure that the depth of the holes exceeds 50mm. The following link is a schematic diagram of step 1. https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com//Knowledge_data_base/user_manual/20250626153037004.png
Step 2: Fix the base
Fit the expansion tubes into the holes, pull them tight, and then use the expansion screws (packaged with expansion tube for use) to install and secure the base to the floor. Note the left and right orientation of the base. The following link is a schematic diagram of step 2. https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com//Knowledge_data_base/user_manual/20250626153156101.png
Step 3: Install the battery
Install the module and BDU in order from bottom to top. Observed from both sides of the battery system, make sure that the locking holes on both sides of the battery system overlap, if not, you need to re-adjust the position of the battery to make it overlap. The following link is a schematic diagram of step 3. https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com//Knowledge_data_base/user_manual/20250626153324524.png
Step 4: Install the anti tipping bracket
There are threaded holes on the left and right sides of the BDU. Using the M4x12 screws to install the anti tipping bracket to it. During installation, take care to adjust the position of the anti-tipping bracket. The following link is a schematic diagram of step 4. https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com//Knowledge_data_base/user_manual/20250626153434749.png
Step 5: Locate drill holes on the wall
Using the anti-tipping brackets as a template, use a marker pen to locate on the wall, then drill holes and install expansion screws. Before locking anti tipping biracket, complete power cable connection and communication connection. Note that you need to take down the BDU and a module when drilling and give the battery system a good protection to prevent foreign objects from entering and damaging the equipment. The following link is a schematic diagram of step 5. https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com//Knowledge_data_base/user_manual/20250626153521171.png
Step 6: Fix the battery modules
There are screw holes on the left and right sides of the battery system. Using the M4x12 screws to lock the BDU, modules and base. The distance between the battery and the inverter should be about 400mm. The following link is a schematic diagram of step 6. https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com//Knowledge_data_base/user_manual/20250626153600707.png
Note:
1) Install the battery system in the order of base, module, BDU, pay attention to the up and down direction, please do not reverse.
(2) High voltage products of different models cannot be mixed and stacked. High-voltage stacked modules must be of the same module with the same cell capacity and SOC.
3) With the exception of new battery modules that can be stacked directly for the first time, all other used batteries must be discharged to cutoff voltage or fully chargedand meet capacity requirements before stacking.
4) When connecting battery systems in parallel, ensure that tlhe usable energy of each battery system is the same.

cases.name: ANSWER-AB-006
cases.query: 1. In grid wiring of HESS-HY-S-12K-S inverter, what are precautions for connecting the parallel connecting lines?
cases.reference:
This is HESS-HY-S-12K-S inverter. And there are some precautions for connecting the parallel connecting lines. In GRID wiring, Parallel connection in single phase: ensure L-to-L, N-to-N and PE-to-PE connection for all solar storage inverters, and that the connection is correct with the same wiring length and line diameter before power on so as to avoid the abnormal operation of parallel system output casused by wrong connection. Meanwhile, it is not allowed to have multiple different AC source inputs to avoid damage to the external equipment of the inverter. The consistency and uniqueness of AC source input shall be ensured. 
Parallel connection in three-phase: ensure N-to-Nand PE-to-PE connection for all solar storage inverters. The L lines of all inverters connected to the same phase need to bee connected together. But L lines of different phases cannot be joined together. Other connectionprecautions are the same as parallel
connection in single phase. For specific wiring, please refer to 2.4.4Wiring Diagram.

cases.name: ANSWER-AB-007
cases.query: 1. Does the HESS-HY-S-3~6K inverter include Export active power control?
cases.reference:
This is a HESS-HY-S-3~6K inverter. The product is equipped with the export active power limit function, so as to meet the requirements of some national standards or grid standards for limiting the output power at the grid connection point. The export active power control solution measures the active power at the point where the customer’s installation is connected to the distribution system (point of grid connection) and then uses this information to control the inverter’s output active power in order to prevent the export active power to the distribution system from exceeding the agreed export capacity. 
The smart meter that can be used with this product must be approved by Hanchu ESS. For more information about the smart meter, please contact the service.

cases.name: ANSWER-AB-011
cases.query: 1. Can u give me some HOME-ESS-HV-2.7K battery maintenance safety requirements?
cases.reference:
This is HOME-ESS-HV-2.7K battery. Here are some battery maintenance safety requirements. When the equipment is running, a high voltage may cause electric shocks and result in death, serious injury or property damage. Before performing maintenance, turn off the equipment and strictly follow the safety
precautions listed in this manual and other related documents.
Ensure that you are familiar with the contents of this manual and have appropriate tools and test equipment to perform maintenance.
Before performing maintenance, turn off the equipment according to the instructions and wait for a certain period of time to ensure that the equipment is power-off.
During maintenance, prevent unnecessary personnel from getting close to the maintenance site.
Temporary warning signs or fences must be erected to isolate the site.
If the equipment fails, please contact your dealer in time to deal with it.
The equipment can only be power-on again after the fault has been dealt with. Otherwise, the equipment may have some problems or become damaged.
Do not dissemble the product without authorization. There is a danger of electric shocks and the corresponding failure is not covered by the warranty.
Maintenance personnel should have received the professional training and use protective tools to conduct maintenance.
When it is necessary to move or rewire, the input power must be cut off. Wait for 5 minutes to ensure that the internal energy of the machine has been discharged. The maintenance should be started after confirming with a multimeter that there is no dangerous voltage and no parts need to be repaired inside the machine.
Maintenance of batteries should be performed or supervised by someone who is familiar with batteries and required precautions.
Please use the same type of cell when replacing cells.
After maintenance, immediately check that no tools or other parts have been left inside the equipment.
If the equipment has not been used for a long time, you need to store and charge the battery according to this manual.
All operators of the energy storage system shall comply with the user manual. Any equipment damage caused by neglecting or misreading the user manual, will void the product warranty.

cases.name: ANSWER-AB-012
cases.query:
1. What is the correct shutdown sequence for parallel HOME-ESS-HV-5.12K battery systems?
2. How long can the HOME-ESS-HV-5.12K battery sit powered off without damage?
cases.reference:
This is HOME-ESS-HV-5.12K battery. Here is equipment debugging. 
5. Equipment Power Down
1) First, turn off the inverter.
2) Turn off the power switch of the subordinate battery system and the primary battery system in turn. The battery system is in "Standby" after completing "Power off".
3) Turn off the circuit breaker switch on the BDU in the order of the Primary Battery System, Subordinate Battery System 1, Subordinate Battery System 2 and SubordinateBattery System 3. 
The following link is a schematic diagram of how to do equipment power down. https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com//Knowledge_data_base/user_manual/20250625153050475.png
Note: There is an inherent self-discharge loss of the battery system after it has been de-energised. If the battery system does not require work, it is recommended that the button be switched off and the circuit breaker be set to OFF, otherwise damage to the battery due to over-discharge may result.

cases.reference:
不是给“每个边境口岸”单独分名额，而是盯着“可能堵车的路段”给名额。电力里，“车=电”，“路=输电线路”，“堵车的路段=可能拥塞的关键线路”。
为什么这么干？
电从A国到B国，不只走一条线，真实潮流会在整张网里分散流动。
如果你只给“边境口岸”按条数分额（老办法 NTC），常常浪费路：有的路空着，有的路堵死。
流域法改成：看哪些路段会堵，把它们的“还能再过多少车（电）”当成约束，一起算。
具体怎么做（用交通比喻）
挑路段：先挑出可能会堵的路段（关键线路）。
量影响：任何一个口岸多放1辆车，会让每条路段多挤多少？（这就是“影响系数”）
定剩余：每条易堵路段还能承受多少辆车？（“剩余空间”）
一起算：撮合交易时，让车尽量多地、聪明地分流，但任何路段都不能超载。
结果：能用到更多真实可用的路，总体更省钱、更高效、更安全。
和老办法的区别（超直白版）
老办法 NTC：每个口岸各发各的“今天最多能过 X 辆”，互相不管 → 容易浪费。
流域法 FB：大家共同争取“那些会堵的路段”的剩余空间 → 更贴近物理、可交易空间通常更大。
对价格意味着什么？
不堵时：各地价格更容易靠近（因为电能顺着空路段流过去）。
一旦某条关键路段“卡脖子”：出现价格差，差的大小就反映哪里在“堵”。

cases.query: HESS-HY-T-4~20K逆变器如何兼容旁路光伏逆变器？
cases.reference:
### HESS-HY-T-4~20K逆变器与已有光伏逆变器的兼容解决方案
汉储HESS-HY-T-4~20K逆变器提供与已有光伏逆变器的兼容解决方案，下面我会详细解释。
1. **AC耦合安装**：
- HESS-HY-T-4~20K逆变器支持AC耦合安装，这意味着它可以与现有的旁路光伏逆变器协同工作。通过AC耦合，光伏系统产生的电力会根据hanchu逆变器的工作模式进行协调，分配至负载，电池，或电网。
- 在这种配置中，已有光伏逆变器可以作为储能系统的一部分，优化能源使用，提高系统的灵活性和可靠性。
2. **智能电表集成**：
- 该逆变器支持与智能电表（iESS-M1）集成，这有助于实时监控和管理能源流动。通过将智能电表接在已有光伏逆变器上，系统可以更精确获取旁路光伏的数据，确保能源的高效利用。
3. **安装指南**：
- 在安装过程中，您需要确保所有连接正确无误，包括光伏逆变器、储能逆变器、智能电表以及负载之间的连接。建议您参考Hanchu提供的安装指导进行操作。
希望这些信息对您有所帮助！如果您有其他问题或需要进一步的帮助，请随时告诉我。具体操作流程可以参考以下视频
https://oss-cdn.hanchuess.com/frontend/document/install/Three-Phase%20Inverter%20%2B%20Smart%20Meter%EF%BC%88SDM630%EF%BC%89%2B%20AC%20Coupling%20Installation%20Guide.mp4

cases.name: ANSWER-AB-037
cases.query: 如何设置设备在低电价时充电？
cases.reference:
### 如何设置设备在低电价时充电？
为了在低电价时段为您的设备充电，您可以按照以下步骤进行设置：
#### 1. **检查电价时段**
- **了解电价时段**：首先，您需要了解您家接入的电价是峰谷电价。通常，低谷时段电价较低，适合充电。
#### 2. **设置user-defined模式**
- **填写电价**：
进入电站编辑页面，根据实际峰谷电价，填写买入价格和卖出价格
- **设置充电时间段**：
1. 在Hanchu APP或Web界面中，进入“device”>“inverter”>“energy storage settigns”>“working mode”切换至user-defined模式。
2. 在user-defined模式下，将低电价时段设置为充电时间段。例如，设置23:00至7:00为充电时间段。
3. 在该时段内，系统将以最大充电功率给储能充电。
#### 3. **优化充电设置**
- **设置充电参数**：
1. 您可以为每个时间段设置工作模式和参数。例如，设置充电功率、充电截止SOC等。
2. 确保充电设置符合您的需求，以最大化节省电费。
#### 4. **监控与调整**
- **监控充电情况**：定期监控电池的充放电情况，确保充电按预设的低电价时段进行。
- **调整设置**：根据实际使用情况和电价变化，及时调整自定义计划。
### 总结
通过设置user-defined模式，您可以在低电价时段为设备充电，从而节省电费。确保您了解当地的电价时段，并根据这些时段设置执行计划。如果您在设置过程中遇到任何问题，建议联系Hanchu的技术支持团队获取帮助。
希望这些信息对您有所帮助！如果您有其他问题或需要进一步的帮助，请随时告知。

This is CESS-HV-9.4K battery. Here are some battery maintenance safety requirements. When the equipment is running, a high voltage may cause electric shocks and result in death, serious injury or property damage. Before performing maintenance, turn off the equipment and strictly follow the safety precautions listed in this manual and other related documents.
Ensure that you are familiar with the contents of this manual and have appropriate tools and test equipment to perform maintenance.
Before performing maintenance, turn off the equipment according to the instructions and wait for a certain period of time to ensure that the equipment is power-off.
During maintenance, prevent unnecessary personnel from getting close to the maintenance site.
Temporary warning signs or fences must be erected to isolate the site.
If the equipment fails, please contact your dealer in time to deal with it.
The equipment can only be power-on again after the fault has been dealt with. Otherwise, the equipment may have some problems or become damaged.
Do not dissemble the product without authorization. There is a danger of electric shocks and the corresponding failure is not covered by the warranty.
Maintenance personnel should have received the professional training and use protective tools to conduct maintenance.
When it is necessary to move or rewire, the input power must be cut off. Wait for 5 minutes to ensure that the internal energy of the machine has been discharged. The maintenance should be started after confirming with a multimeter that there is no dangerous voltage and no parts need to be repaired inside the machine.
Maintenance of batteries should be performed or supervised by someone who is familiar with batteries and required precautions.
Please use the same type of cell when replacing cells.
After maintenance, immediately check that no tools or other parts have been left inside the equipment.
If the equipment has not been used for a long time, you need to store and charge the battery according to this manual.
All operators of the energy storage system shall comply with the user manual. Any equipment damage caused by neglecting or misreading the user manual, will void the product warranty.

cases.name: ANSWER-AB-047
cases.query: 1. Does the HESS-HY-T-5~12K inverter include Back-up function?
cases.reference:
This is a HESS-HY-T-5~12K inverter. The product is equipped with a back-up function which also called as an emergency power supply (EPS). The back-up function ensures that the inverter forms a three-phase back-up grid that uses energy from the battery and the PV system that is directly connected to the inverter to supply the critical load in the event of a utility grid failure. 
In the event of a grid failure, the product disconnects from the grid. The product provides a standalone grid and the backup loads, which connect to EPS connector, continue to be supplied by the energy stored in the battery and the PV modules.
The charging of the battery is ensured by the existing PV system during back-up operation.
As soon as the utility grid is available again, the product will automatically connect to the grid and the loads are supplied with energy from the utility grid.

cases.query: 我有一个低压电池，电池型号为HOME-ESS-LV-3.2K/HOME-ESS-LV-9.4K/HOME-ESS-LV-5.12K/HOME-ESS-LV-3.68K。我的电池出现了“SPI通信失效”告警，该告警的触发原因是什么？有没有对应的解决办法，解决办法是什么？

cases.name: ANSWER-AB-060
cases.query: What should I do if my Hanchu Three Phase 15/20K inverter shows "Relay Check Fail" error?
cases.reference:
Internal relay self-check failed (or N/PE connection poor).
Action: Measure voltage between N&PE (should be <10V). Restart inverter.
[View Guide](https://hanchuess-file-eu.oss-eu-central-1.aliyuncs.com/Knowledge_data_base/shouce/Hanchu%20Three%20Phase%20Hybrid%20-%2015-20K%20-%20Error%20Codes%20QA%20Customer%20Friendly.pdf#page=7)
